decisions.reason: As a core two-component resin injection unit in a long-cycle industrial portfolio, it would usually be retained unless demand has clearly fallen short of expectations.
This resin injection unit still fits the firm's core business, but overlap with another similar unit makes portfolio rationalization somewhat more likely by 2022.
An automatic airless spray gun supports the firm's industrial coating applications and is likely to stay unless its more specialized automation niche proves too small.
A manual airless spray gun is a standard, service-friendly product for established customers, so a medium German machinery firm would normally continue offering it.
A multi-model air-assisted airless spray gun line signals sustained commitment across customer specifications, which makes near-term withdrawal unlikely.

The data logger supports modernization but is the least central to the firm's mechanical core and is the most plausible candidate for discontinuation if uptake has remained limited or functionality can be absorbed elsewhere.
